content: शङ्कुः [शङ्क्-उण् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 36</ls>] .²1 A dart, spear, spike, javelin, dagger; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>; शोकशङ्कुः ‘the dart of grief’, <ab>i. e.</ab> sharp or poignant grief; तथैव तीव्रो हृदि शोकशङ्कुर्मर्माणि कृन्तन्नपि किं न सोढः <ls>U. 3. 35</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 93</ls>; <ls>Ki. 16. 15</ls>. .²2 A stake, pillar, post, pale; महासुहयः सैन्धवः पड्वीशशङ्कून् संवृहेत् <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 1. 13</ls>; निखातशङ्कुसंबद्धसैन्धवश्रेणिसंयुतम् <ls>Śiva B. 20. 53</ls>. .²3 A nail, pin, peg; बभूवुः सप्त दुर्धर्षाः खादिरैः शङ्कुभिश्चिताः <ls>Mb. 3. 284. 3</ls>; अयःशङ्कुचितां रक्षः शतघ्नीमथ शत्रवे (अक्षिपत्) <ls>R. 12. 95</ls>. .²4 The sharp head or point of an arrow, barb; <ls>Dk. 1. 1</ls>. .²5 The trunk (of a lopped tree), stump, pollard. .²6 The pin of a dial. .²7 A measure of twelve fingers. .²8 A measuring-rod. .²9 The sine of altitude (in <ab>astr.</ab>). .²10 Ten billions. .²11 The fibres of a leaf; यथा शङ्कुना सर्वाणि पर्णानि संतृण्णानि <ls>Ch. Up. 2. 23. 3</ls>. .²12 An ant-hill. .²13 The penis. .²14 The skate-fish. .²15 A demon. .²16 Poison. .²17 Sin; crime. .²18 An aquatic animal, particularly, a goose. .²19 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²20 The Sāla tree. .²21 A kind of perfume (नखी). .²22 <ab>N.</ab> of Kāma, the god of love.
